visualCharacteristics:
rc8: White band; image left (portrait photo with logoline accent), text right: orange H2 "Industry fluency, Microsoft depth", paragraph, arrow link "Explore our industry expertise". Two columns: large portrait image beside heading, text and arrow link; image side alternates by cell order.
rc9: White band; text left, image right (canyon photo): H2 "Services built for real world impact", paragraph, "Explore our services" link. Same image/text split as rc8 with image on the right (cell order).
rc10: Light grey (#f6f7fb) highlighted band; image left, text right: H2 "From the people deploying it first", paragraph, 4 bold article links with red left rule, "Explore more insights" link. Same image/text split; extra list of article links in the text cell is handled by the same code.
rc13: Magenta-to-orange linear gradient band (90deg #ce0569 -> #ff5800) with logoline curve; white H2 "A career that matters", paragraph and white "Explore careers" button left, staircase photo right. Same text/image split on the gradient section; gradient comes from section style.

contentPattern.authoring: One row per split: an image-only cell and a text cell (heading, paragraph, optional list, CTA). Put the image first for image-left, last for image-right. Highlights option: in the text cell, each paragraph that starts with bold text (bold title, then description) gets the magenta-to-orange left rule; bullet lists keep the same rule.

cells: H2, paragraphs each starting with a bold title

usage.description: Two-column image beside text; image side follows cell order.

reuseGuidance: Use for alternating image/text feature rows. Section backgrounds (grey, gradient) come from section-metadata.
